description: L-Tryptophan displays a strong aromatic absorption band at ~219 nm (epsilon ~33000) from the indole pi-pi* 1Bb transition, and a characteristic near-UV band at 278 nm (epsilon ~5600) from the 1La pi-pi* transition of the indole ring, with a vibronic shoulder near 288 nm.
clinicalNote: The 278 nm band of tryptophan residues (epsilon approx 5540 per residue) is the primary basis for A280 protein concentration determination in biochemistry and biopharmaceutical quality control.

sources.purpose: Chemical identity, molecular formula (C11H12N2O2) and molecular weight (204.23 g/mol)
epsilon(280 nm) = 5540 per tryptophan residue in native proteins, statistical determination across >30 proteins (Mach et al., Anal Biochem 1992)
